We provide personalized, proactive dental care with a focus on your long-term oral and overall health.Unlike corporate dental chains, we spend quality, unrushed time with every patient identifying root causes of issues such as cavities, cracked teeth, bleeding gums, TMJ disorders, and more. Your comfort, trust, and safety are at the center of everything we do. 15+ Years of Experience Advanced Diagnostic Technology Comfort-Focused Care Personalized Treatment Plans Office Hours Mon 8AM - 5PM Tue 8AM - 5PM Wed 8AM - 5PM Thu 8AM - 5PM Fri By Appointment Sat Closed Sun Closed Book Appointment Call For Emergency Meet the Doctor Dr. West Welcome to the new West Family Dentistry now serving the greater northwest valley including Peoria, Glendale, Phoenix, Sun City and Surprise communities. We prioritize a personalized and proactive approach to your oral and overall health. Free from corporate influence, our practice is centered on spending quality time with each patient to thoroughly assess risks and address the underlying causes of dental issues such as cavities, cracked teeth, TMJ disorders, bleeding gums, and more. Personalized, gentle dental care Honest, patient-first treatment Modern techniques for lasting results Trusted local family dentist Dr. West CEO & FOUNDER Patient Testimonials We’re proud to be a trusted dental provider in Peoria, AZ. Our practice is built around personal attention, high standards, and clinical skill. Patients appreciate our clear communication, welcoming atmosphere, and experienced team. See what our patients say about us! Read All Reviews 0 + Reviews Patricia Desi Doherty Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. Dr. West reminds me of the dentists that I used to work for back in New York. He’s so knowledgeable, professional, kind, funny and he does exceptional work. You don’t need to look any further because Dr. West is the real deal. He is such a genuine human being who truly cares about his patients. Audra Locklear Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. I had the best experience with Dr West and his team! The past couple of years I have gone to a few different dentist offices around the NW valley and had horrible experiences with just getting my fillings! Ugh 83rd Ave put the numbing in wrong and caused me to have a panic attack from the Epi in it. They just were rushed and only cared about updating you. Then I went to Canyon Dental and I was in the chair for 3 hours on two fillings! They tore my tongue up and I was numb until dinner.. just horrible! So I was a little apprehensive about getting more fillings. But Dr. West and his team were amazing! He truly listens and used the numbing solution without epi, I was only numb for a little while so when I left I could actually drink water! He was so fast and efficient and later that day I forgot I even had dental work done. I was just sooo grateful!! Nina P. Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. Great office with amazing staff!!!! Cindy Bouch Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. Love the new team! Liz Staackmann Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. My husband and I came in for cleaning/new patient exam. We were very happy with the staff and services we received. Jessie Walters Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. Dr. West and his staff are great. Cleaning was painless and fast. Staff is courteous and explained cleaning equipment. Dr. West is reviews everything with you. Thank you Smile Institute! Karen Manning Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. While visiting my son in Phoenix I needed dental work. Dr West was the best, he was able to help so glad I found him. Rosanna Teneyuque Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. Dr. West is my go to dentist when I’m in the Phoenix area. He’s the best. He explains everything that he’s doing and my dental experience is basically pain free. Thank you! Tinsley Hammond Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. Dr. West does an incredible job; his attention to detail is unmatched! I will definitely be going back for all my dental needs. Evan Kirby Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. Dr. West is only person I trust with my teeth. Every one of those five stars are well deserved!
